title: Equilibrium Points of a Predator-Prey System
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the equilibrium points in the first quadrant of the predator-prey system dx/dt = x(2 - y), dy/dt = y(x - 3).

steps.title: Set Both Derivatives Equal to Zero
steps.explanation: Equilibrium requires both time rates to be zero.

steps.title: Case 1: Extinction Equilibrium
steps.explanation: Trivial state with no predators and no prey.

steps.title: Case 2: Coexistence Equilibrium
steps.mathExpression: x \ne 0 \implies 2 - y = 0 \implies y = 2; \quad y \ne 0 \implies x - 3 = 0 \implies x = 3 \implies (3, 2)
